U_0x010B1E:
IThe eighth prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." It pairs a main body built on data from Cerberus with an add-on armament unit, the "Ignite Parts." A new TE Engine gives it more output and stability than Cerberus, and an energy field called the "TE Sphere" boosts its defense.
The Ignite Parts can fly alone as an unmanned fighter but are normally mounted on the Cerberus Ignite itself. The body also transforms between the melee form "Figure W" and the bombardment form "Figure B" (front and back reverse), giving it high versatility. Figure W with the Ignite Parts attached, called "Form G," excels at close combat.

U_0x011496:
MThe fifth prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." Dr. Mitarl Zapad, its central figure, created the "TE Engine," an application of "Terminus Energy," and the self-repairing armor material "Razmnanium." Both proved hard to control; after trial and error on prototypes 1-4, Mitarl shelved a machine carrying both. Razmnanium went to prototype 5, Medius Locus, and the TE Engine to prototypes 6 and 7, Cerberus and Garmraid, each pursuing its own function.
Medius Locus was built on <Personal Trooper> data; though its output trails the TE Engine units, it boasts high mobility and responsiveness.
U_0x01194A: The transformed Medius Locus. Using the data AI1 gathered, it changed form via Razmnanium's self-evolution, gaining vast power. Now far larger, its shape and arms resemble an <S.Unit>'s - likely because Erde, wary of the tenth TE Absorber prototype, pushed AI1 to grow to rival it.
U_0x011BA1: The tenth and effectively final prototype TE Absorber. "Galvus" merges "Garmraid" and "Cerberus (Kerberos)"; another name is "MODEL-X." Carrying all the project's fruits - the TE Engine, Razmnanium and AI1 - it is in theory maintenance-free and runs semi-permanently. Blending Cerberus Ignite and Garmraid Blaze, it takes forms resembling each: "Form G" (Garmraid) excels at melee, "Form C" (Cerberus) at gunnery. Fully AI1-controlled, it fulfills missions without fail, unswayed by emotion and working where humans cannot.
U_0x011FC1:
A humanoid mobile weapon of the Gaia Sabers' Alpha Saber, built from data on the captured "Lestgemira" (Earth codename: Geminira), an unmanned variable weapon of the <Inspectors>. Keeping its flexible frame and wide joints, the Canis is highly mobile and responsive and mounts a high-performance <Tesla Drive>; its transform gear was cut for cost.
The short gap from its appearance to mass production leaves its origins murky.
